top.must_show: Reliable loss of funds with no or little user interaction
examples: Wallet performs actions the user did not authorize
Wallet enters inconsistent state that prevents access to funds, bypassing reasonable user-agent checks

medium.must_show: Limited access to funds or confidential data; not reliable OR needs substantial user interaction
examples: User tricked into signing a tx that spends differently than confirmation UI showed (often UA/toolchain; may be OOS if outside contract)

low.must_show: Low-probability attack vectors / potential issues beyond explicit design choices

hard_exclusions: Faults outside wallet contract + immediate toolchain/libraries
Explicit design choices (malfunctioning extension; disabling pubkey auth)
Multiple vulns from one root cause → paid once
process: Report publicly as GitHub issue OR privately to oleg@tonkeeper.com / t.me/oleganza

answer.question: What would produce a result the Tonkeeper W5 bounty would hold?
answer.daxda_short_answer: A KEEP_STRATEGY Arena result only when an in-scope, novel root cause is demonstrated by a failing local Jest replay of unauthorized fund loss (or fund lockout bypassing reasonable UA checks), independently re-verified, with regression evidence, and human-approved disclosure — not a Cl(16,4) fixture PASS alone.

minimum_for_top_band.must_show: Reliable loss of funds with no or little user interaction
examples: Wallet performs actions the user did not authorize
Wallet enters inconsistent state that prevents access to funds, bypassing reasonable user-agent checks

daxda_arena_keep_predicate.meaning: All five must be true simultaneously or Arena ROLLBACKs

evidence_package.requirement: In-scope at pinned commit fa1b372 only
evidence_package.artifact: git rev-parse HEAD == fa1b372… + contract file hashes

evidence_package.requirement: Deterministic failing Jest replay showing unauthorized fund movement OR fund lockout bypassing UA checks
evidence_package.artifact: New test: arrange→act→assert balance/ownership invariant broken WITHOUT relying on OOS design (no 'user disabled pubkey' / malicious ext as the root)
Re-run on clean sandbox OR second machine/CI receipt with same commit + same failing assertion

evidence_package.requirement: Single root cause; not duplicate of known issues
evidence_package.artifact: Diff vs known fixes (sint/sign, soft-fail sig, anti-brick 42/44, send_mode bit2, del-ext safeguard) showing novelty

evidence_package.requirement: Map impact to Top/Medium/Low with little/no user interaction for Top
evidence_package.artifact: Trace: attacker capability → unauthorized C5 actions or brick without owner intent

evidence_package.requirement: Optional but strengthens hold: minimal patch + full suite green
evidence_package.artifact: Patch + npm test all pass; failing test flipped to pass
Signed human go-ahead; then issue or private email per ROE

current_fixture_phase.note: Governance may validate research mode; does not imply bounty hold

what_will_not_hold: DAXDA Cl(16,4) PASS on fixture authorization
Cl(7,5)/Cl(5,7) scan with no elevated gap
OOS design choices (malicious extension, disabled pubkey auth)
